title: Single Polynomial Description of Binary Tensor Gram Loci
statement: For real binary tensors of fixed format, can the Gram locus be described semialgebraically by the nonnegativity of a single polynomial?
background:
Collected from Oberwolfach Reports, which document mathematical workshops and their open-problem discussions.

**Source report:** [Algebraic Statistics (2018), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2017/20, pp. 1207--1279](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2017/20)

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-21)

**Status:** partially solved

**Assessment.** The Gram locus is characterized for three binary factors and its convex hull is known in general, but the proposed single-polynomial description for n at least 4 remains conjectural.

**Sources checked.**

- [Seigal on Gram determinants](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6051437/)
- [original OWR report](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2017/20)
